notes:
A design's part is tied to its number, not its name [skip ci]

Owner: "when a part's name changes no action is needed — it is tied to the part's number". The parts table keeps the
names of the day it was saved; a LEVEL7 and MTM design's part renamed afterwards was refused («other design version?»)
and its order held. A design's part is now taken by its number alone and the row shows the design's name of today (a
GRAFIS model's parts are compared as before). «القطع الثابتة» said «not in the model» for a part without a name (the
owner's 007-010): only a number the design does not have is marked. Both tests fail on 2.0.16.
